## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** — All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. Every design property, layout rule, and state is targeted via class or ID selectors only. HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic — restyling the page must never require markup edits.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** — Every color, radius, shadow, spacing, transition, z-index, and font is a `:root`/theme variable per §0.2. **Contrast pairing:** any light background token pairs with a dark text token and any dark background token pairs with a light text token — enforced in both themes, not just the default.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode** — Define Dark tokens both via `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` **and** explicit `[data-theme="dark"]` / `[data-theme="light"]` overrides placed *after* the media block, so a stored choice always wins; first paint uses the media query (no flash, no inline scripts). A visible toggle (header, §0.5) persists the choice to `localStorage`, falls back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, updates `aria-pressed` and a dynamic `aria-label`, and swaps `dark_mode`/`light_mode` glyphs. **Spec exception (Light-first):** the source specification designates Light as the primary presentation — polish Light as the default, but Dark Mode remains fully mandatory with complete token parity (the "after-dark" showcase).

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** — Components use Flexbox; **every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment. All layouts are mobile-first and reflow to single columns on small viewports; the page must never scroll horizontally. Use CSS Grid for section scaffolding (hero columns, card grids, footer columns) per the `grid-layout` keyword; Flexbox inside components.

**1.5 Framework Choice** — Hand-authored **custom CSS** (the effect stack — backdrop-filter, blend modes, keyframes — warrants it), optionally organized with Tailwind-style `@layer` ordering. All utilities map back to CSS variables or reusable blocks (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

**1.6 Google Fonts & Icons** — Per §0.4: text via Google Fonts `<link>`, icons via Material Symbols. No other font or icon sources are permitted.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Buttons** — All states via classes: **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum 44×44px touch target. **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift + `cursor: pointer` (primary CTAs also get a gradient sheen sweep). **Focus:** distinct ring built from variables (`outline` + offset or `box-shadow`), visible in both themes. **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. **Loading:** interactions disabled to prevent double-clicks, `aria-busy`, spinning `progress_activity` glyph, **dimensions unchanged**. **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. **Success/Error:** transient styles driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`. Variants: `.btn--primary` (aurora gradient, `#060918` text), `.btn--glass`, `.btn--ghost`, and `.btn--danger` — visually distinct in both Light and Dark themes even if unused.

**2.2 Cards** — **Default:** flexible Flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary`/glass surfaces, subtle borders, tokenized elevation. **Hover:** `translateY(-2px)` plus shadow/glow shift. **Focus-within:** border highlight when a child control receives focus. **Loading:** `.skeleton` shimmer keyframes defined in CSS, sized to prevent layout jumps. **Empty state:** structured `.empty-state` fallback (Material icon + guidance text).

**2.3 Forms & Inputs** — Structure: flex `.input-group` wrapping `<label>`, `<input>`, and a **dedicated error container** (`aria-live="polite"`). Style every state: empty, focused (aurora-tinted ring), filled, valid (success border + `check_circle`), invalid (error border, error text + `error` icon — never color-only), disabled, read-only. Hero form: validation on blur + submit, password visibility toggle (`aria-pressed`), submit runs loading → success with an `aria-live` confirmation; `preventDefault`, no navigation.

**2.4 Modal** — "Forgot password?" opens a glass modal with **Opening / Open / Loading / Success / Closing** states, all animated via CSS transitions. Centered flex overlay (`align-items: center`) with blurred scrim, `close` icon button (`aria-label="Close dialog"`), `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal`, keyboard **focus trapping**, closing via `Esc` and scrim click, focus returned to the trigger. Contains an email input (§2.3) and a "Send reset link" button (loading → success message).

**2.5 FAQ Accordion** — Each question is a native `<button>` with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`; each panel is `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby`. Chevron `expand_more` rotates 180°; height animates via CSS (`grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` technique or equivalent). Fully keyboard operable; visible focus rings; single-open behavior.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default** — fluid type and spacing, no horizontal overflow, touch targets ≥44px.
- **Motion** — every state change transitions with `var(--transition-normal)`; **all animation (orb drift, tilt, parallax, shimmer, reveals) is disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`**; never animate `backdrop-filter` (transform/opacity only); use `will-change` sparingly.
- **Accessibility (a11y)** — AA contrast in both modes, including text over translucent glass (composite the backdrop; do not guess). Never rely on color alone to communicate state. Semantic HTML5 landmarks, logical DOM/focus order, a skip-to-content link, full keyboard operability, and `aria-live` regions for all dynamic feedback (form results, modal status, optional glass toast layered at `--z-toast`).
- **Mandatory visual feedback** — every click, hover, focus, and submission produces a visible state change.
- **Progressive enhancement** — content is fully visible without JS; scroll-reveal only activates after `script.js` adds a `js` class to `<html>` (hidden `.reveal` states are gated behind that class; IntersectionObserver adds `.is-visible`).

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

- **Files:** `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. The only script tag is one deferred `script.js` reference. Zero inline styles, zero inline event handlers; all JS hooks use `js-` prefixed classes or `data-*` attributes.
- **Naming:** strict **BEM** (`block__element--modifier`) across the entire deliverable — never mix conventions.
- **Copy:** all user-facing copy in English, real and on-theme (no lorem ipsum); no external images — avatars are gradient initial circles; placeholders only where content is genuinely unspecified.
- **Completeness:** the page must render and function fully on the first attempt in modern browsers, including `-webkit-backdrop-filter` support and `@supports` fallbacks for glass surfaces.
